name: mrscraper
description: MrScraper retrieves web pages and Google results for developers building datasets and data-processing workflows. Retrieve a specified URL as HTML, Markdown, a screenshot, or a combination; discover URLs through Google search; and check account usage and remaining tokens. A MrScraper account is required. Page retrieval and search contact external websites through MrScraper. Use third-party sources only where you have authorization and comply with their terms.
